technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and trending ADX, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 81, StochRSI OB) and negative CMF create pullback risk; better suited for profit-taking or waiting for retracement entry.

fundamental.summary: CB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 96 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (92-98 days old) with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (293.76), and negative macro score (-4) create hostile environment for financials despite falling DXY and distant earnings event.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major MAs with bullish supertrend and contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (32/100) offers technical structure and sentiment opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 81, StochRSI OB), negative CMF, crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, zero fundamental conviction, and no insider/institutional support create exhaustion and macro headwinds that outweigh technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major MAs and supertrend confirmation, but extreme overbought RSI (81) and negative CMF signal exhaustion at resistance rather than accumulation.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (293.76), inverted yield curve, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create macro headwinds that will likely trigger pullback before any meaningful upside; overbought technicals offer poor risk/reward.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical strength insufficient to overcome macro deterioration and fundamental weakness
